% Eqs. (4)-(9): basis functions of the isotypic components (phi = golden ratio), generated by the projectors; Eq. (11): P6
\begin{align*}
\ell=1,\ T_{1u}:\quad x &= x \\ y &= y \\ z &= z \\
\ell=2,\ H_g:\quad xy &= xy \\ yz &= yz \\ zx &= xz \\ x^2-y^2 &= x^{2} - y^{2} \\ 2z^2-x^2-y^2 &= -x^{2} - y^{2} + 2\,z^{2} \\
\ell=3,\ T_{2u}:\quad f_x &= x^{3} + (3\varphi - 3)\,xy^{2} - 3\varphi\,xz^{2} \\ f_y &= -3\varphi\,x^{2}y + y^{3} + (3\varphi - 3)\,yz^{2} \\ f_z &= (3\varphi - 3)\,x^{2}z - 3\varphi\,y^{2}z + z^{3} \\
\ell=3,\ G_u:\quad g_x &= x^{3} - (1 + \varphi)\,xy^{2} + (\varphi - 2)\,xz^{2} \\ g_y &= (\varphi - 2)\,x^{2}y + y^{3} - (1 + \varphi)\,yz^{2} \\ g_z &= -(1 + \varphi)\,x^{2}z + (\varphi - 2)\,y^{2}z + z^{3} \\ xyz &= xyz \\
\ell=4,\ G_g:\quad u_0 &= x^{4} - 3\,x^{2}y^{2} - 3\,x^{2}z^{2} + y^{4} - 3\,y^{2}z^{2} + z^{4} \\ u_x &= x^{2}yz + \tfrac{\varphi - 1}{3}\,y^{3}z - \tfrac{\varphi}{3}\,yz^{3} \\ u_y &= -\tfrac{\varphi}{3}\,x^{3}z + xy^{2}z + \tfrac{\varphi - 1}{3}\,xz^{3} \\ u_z &= \tfrac{\varphi - 1}{3}\,x^{3}y - \tfrac{\varphi}{3}\,xy^{3} + xyz^{2} \\
\ell=4,\ H_g:\quad v_x &= x^{4} - 3\,x^{2}y^{2} - 3\,x^{2}z^{2} - \tfrac{1}{2}\,y^{4} + 6\,y^{2}z^{2} - \tfrac{1}{2}\,z^{4} \\ v_y &= -\tfrac{1}{2}\,x^{4} - 3\,x^{2}y^{2} + 6\,x^{2}z^{2} + y^{4} - 3\,y^{2}z^{2} - \tfrac{1}{2}\,z^{4} \\ v_z &= -\tfrac{1}{2}\,x^{4} + 6\,x^{2}y^{2} - 3\,x^{2}z^{2} - \tfrac{1}{2}\,y^{4} - 3\,y^{2}z^{2} + z^{4} \\ w_x &= x^{2}yz + \tfrac{1 - 7\varphi}{15}\,y^{3}z + \tfrac{7\varphi - 6}{15}\,yz^{3} \\ w_y &= \tfrac{7\varphi - 6}{15}\,x^{3}z + xy^{2}z + \tfrac{1 - 7\varphi}{15}\,xz^{3} \\ w_z &= \tfrac{1 - 7\varphi}{15}\,x^{3}y + \tfrac{7\varphi - 6}{15}\,xy^{3} + xyz^{2} \\
P_6 &= x^{6} + (3 - 21\varphi)\,x^{4}y^{2} + (21\varphi - 18)\,x^{4}z^{2} + (21\varphi - 18)\,x^{2}y^{4} + 90\,x^{2}y^{2}z^{2} + (3 - 21\varphi)\,x^{2}z^{4} + y^{6} + (3 - 21\varphi)\,y^{4}z^{2} + (21\varphi - 18)\,y^{2}z^{4} + z^{6} \\
\sum_i (\hat a_i\cdot\hat n)^6 &= -\tfrac{2}{35}\,P_6 + \tfrac{6}{7}\,r^6 \quad(\text{Eq. 10; on the unit sphere } r^6 = 1)
\end{align*}
